representation: ISO 8601 UTC string with Z suffix
use: Human-readable event time, logs and UI display
leap_seconds: UTC contains leap seconds; do not convert by fixed offset
conversion_rule: Convert to TDB/ET using an NAIF SPICE LSK and time conversion routines

time_name: Barycentric Dynamical Time / SPICE Ephemeris Time
use: Ephemeris interpolation, SPICE state queries and trajectory time argument
leap_seconds: TDB is continuous; do not treat as UTC clock time
conversion_rule: SPICE ET uses TDB; UTC strings require LSK for conversion

representation: Seconds since a mission-defined start event (usually liftoff)
use: Mission timeline events and elapsed mission display
epoch_or_origin: Must include mission launch epoch and mission definition
leap_seconds: Not itself a civil time scale; store epoch and separate UTC/TDB
conversion_rule: MET = elapsed seconds from explicit mission reference epoch; map to UTC/TDB with mission epoch and time conversion

use: Only when decoding spacecraft instrument or SPICE CK/SCLK products
leap_seconds: Not interchangeable with UTC or TDB
conversion_rule: Requires spacecraft clock kernel (SCLK) plus relevant SPICE kernels
